title: Start a claimed task through the hosted Conduct pipeline
when: A Conduct worker starts its owned generated task through a connected server.
need: Use the authenticated session and an active exact task claim. Parent authority remains valid; another task claim, released claim or payload identity cannot authorize the write. A refusal names the task claim recovery command.
surface: Conduct task-status command and its refusal; task function catalog
review: Real handler, updater and verifier regression uses disposable production-schema data without server ambient identity. Deployed proof belongs to the attached Command case.
